source_row.extraction_instructions: One page with a 'Next events' card grid (upcoming) followed by a 'Past events' grid that loads more by admin-ajax infinite scroll; the Past grid is irrelevant, so the page is cut at that heading and no paging is needed (no ?page= or REST alternative exposes dates). Detail pages (/events/<slug>/) open with 'LIVES, Month D-D, YYYY, City (Venue)' and sometimes a venue line; the annual congress page has three fee grids (member / non-member rows x early / standard / late / one-day columns).

registry_comment: ESICM events: 'Next events' grid only; bespoke header (city/venue) and fee-grid parsing

spot_check.site_says: Core Congress ESICM member Physician: early 630, standard 730, late 830, one day 450 (EUR)
CCL, Lisboa Congress Centre, 1300-307 Lisbon, Portugal

concerns: Site's 'Next events' shows 6 upcoming; the Past grid (52 entries, sorted newest first) was checked and has no future-dated entry. Recon's 'infinite scroll' applies only to the Past grid.

Fees: only the Lisbon congress page has fee grids (52 tiers over three tables, EUR, excl. 23% VAT). Copenhagen 2027, Euro-Brazil, Euro-Japan and LIVES Physiology show no registration yet (LIVES Physiology says 'Registrations Details: Opening end of November 2026'). Intensive Care Innovation 2027 registers on humanitasedu.it, which does list fees (checked: Member 350, Non-member 560, N&AHP 150): organiser_url is set for the explorer.
Country is only stated on the Lisbon page; other events have city only (no country invented). Euro-Brazil header has a stray 'l' after the city, trimmed.
Calls for abstracts (Innovation 2027 portal, LIVES Physiology 'Opening end of November 2026') are left to the merge step; harness shows SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE as expected.
Base CPD regex read 'November 2026 CME Credits' as 2026 points: guarded in the subclass (values above 100 or equal to a year dropped). Base should reject year-like values.

Coverage checklist: (1) multi-day: listing ranges kept as end_date; (2) external fee links: organiser_url set from the Register/Visit link; (3) image fee tables: none seen; (4) same-site registration sub-pages: see per-source note; (5) two-hop: organiser_url handed to explorer; (6) poster competitions: none; (7) call-for-papers/portals left to the merge step (harness coverage shows SUBMISSION_NO_DEADLINE as expected); (8) no CTA text in tier labels.
